title: HSACO allocation inspection cannot reach the portable profile consumer
observation: The existing AMDGCN inspector reads physical VGPR/private/LDS counts, but portable report replay assumes kernel.cubin, the collection CLI requires cuobjdump, and non-CUBIN profiles reject compiled observations. The actual DTK replay has fixed LDS0 and launch dynamic LDS8192 for a large tile; these are distinct and must both remain visible. The initial duplicate-static-LDS hypothesis was rejected by that replay. Separate AMDGPU stack storage is not observed. Actual 192-VGPR/1024-thread HCU output also makes the CUDA per-SM register formula return zero CTAs. HSACO register-bank/wave allocation is not modeled; retain allocation observations but abstain from that bound.
proposed_change: Connect existing HSACO inspection to code-object-bound portable reports and the existing profile/author-feedback CLI. Preserve CUDA v1 report replay, use generic binary identity for HSACO, retain fixed and launch-dynamic LDS separately, and report unobserved stack as null. Keep NCU metrics, dynamic spill traffic and calibrated latency claims absent. Keep HSACO register counts diagnostic-only until a target-owned physical allocation model exists.
promotion_disposition: Promote the bounded reviewed capability after integration checks; preserve original failures and frozen runs. Performance, new shape coverage and equal-budget search benefit remain unproven.

verified_by.scope: Actual DTK CPU-only compilation/replay; no GPU execution or achieved-occupancy/latency claim.
verified_by.software: Independent source review found no blocking issues after recorded corrections. Full contracts and offline compile results are owned by shared PR374/375 and this hardware integration PR.
